You will own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and qualification to closing—while building long-term, trust-based partnerships with senior decision-makers across industries.&nbsp;</p> <p>This position requires a consultative, strategic seller who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values collaboration, and brings proven experience managing complex enterprise accounts.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own and manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to close.</li> <li>Sell C4Media’s evolving enterprise solutions, including&nbsp;<strong>annual subscription-based seat packages</strong> to our software conferences and online learning products by targeting Fortune 1000 / Global 2000.</li> <li>Research, identify, and qualify prospects within target industries and accounts.</li> <li>Apply proven sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC) to qualify opportunities, manage pipeline, and close enterprise deals.</li> <li>Develop and execute account strategies aligned with customer goals, driving both new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li>Build strong, trust-based relationships with executives and stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor.</li> <li>Lead discovery sessions to understand customer challenges, goals, and skills needs, and tailor solutions accordingly.</li> <li>Effectively communicate the value proposition of our solutions through presentations, demos, and executive-level conversations.</li> <li>Provide accurate forecasts,&nbsp;maintain CRM records,&nbsp;and report regularly on pipeline and performance.</li> <li>Stay current on industry trends, competitors, and best practices to continuously refine your approach.</li> <li>Consistently achieve or exceed assigned revenue targets.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A consultative seller who builds trust quickly and acts as a strategic advisor to enterprise clients.</li> <li>Self-motivated, and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership of your business.</li> <li>A team player who thrives in a collaborative environment while operating independently day-to-day.</li> <li>Open to coaching, feedback, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>A confident communicator who can engage credibly at the executive level and adapt your message to any audience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>4–6 years of proven success in enterprise sales, ideally within SaaS, learning solutions, or technology services.</li> <li>Strong track record selling into Fortune 1000 /&nbsp;Global 2000 or large enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Expertise in consultative sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC,Challenger Sales, Solution Selling, or Value Selling.</li> <li>Proven ability to negotiate and close multi-year contracts with senior executives.</li> <li>Experience managing complex pipelines and navigating large organizations.</li> <li>Strong business acumen and understanding of subscription-based business models.</li> <li>Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.</li> <li>Proficiency with sales tools such as HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, and similar platforms.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in business, sales, or a related field preferred.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why work at C4Media</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Work from home - always:</strong> We are a remote-first and remote-always team who has been successfully operating on a work-from-home basis since 2007. And we have no intention of changing that.</li> <li><strong>Travel the world:</strong> C4Media offers an opportunity to travel 3-4 times a year at our expense to NYC, SF, London, and other fun, global locations for conferences &amp; team building. We also got you covered to add a sightseeing day to the end of the trip.</li> <li><strong>Take care of each other:</strong> We look out for one another and prioritize respect, fairness, support, and well-being. Check out our core values on our careers page.</li> <li><strong>Learn something new:</strong> C4Media’s culture is one of learning &amp; mastering. Everyone has a training and education budget for professional growth every year and is encouraged to use it.</li> <li><strong>Make friends across the world:</strong> Be a part of a leading, fast-growing international company and build a network of international friends and colleagues for life.</li> <li><strong>Support wellbeing:</strong> In an effort to make physical activity more readily accessible, we offer staff an annual subsidy towards fitness and wellness.</li> <li><strong>Generous paid time off:</strong> In addition to 25 paid days off in the 1st year and 30 paid days off in every subsequent year, we provide 1 paid day off for birthdays (or a similar special day) and 2 paid days for continuing education.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare:</strong> C4Media offers contributions towards healthcare expenses for US-based employees.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Diversity</strong></h2> <p>Our company culture promotes and encourages a safe environment regardless of gender, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, or religion.
